headline: Kamdhenu Ventures submits SEBI compliance certificate for September quarter
summary: Kamdhenu Ventures Limited has submitted its compliance certificate under Regulation 74(5) of SEBI Regulations for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The filing was made to the stock exchange as part of standard regulatory requirements. This procedural disclosure has no direct impact on the company's financial performance or stock valuation.
why_it_matters: No financial impact for retail investors
